zh.q: 和 Spotlight 有什么不同
zh.a: Spotlight 同时搜索文件内容、应用和网页。Oil Find 的文件搜索针对文件名建立内存索引，支持拼音首字母、通配符和正则表达式；同一个搜索面板还能查找本地 Claude Code、Codex 和 WorkBuddy 对话。
和 Windows 上的 Everything 思路一样：给磁盘上的文件名建一份索引，输入即出结果。Everything 只有 Windows 版，Oil Find 是为 Mac 写的原生应用。

en.a: Spotlight searches file contents, apps, and the web. Oil Find indexes file names in memory, with pinyin, wildcards, and regex. The same panel also searches local conversations from Claude Code, Codex, and WorkBuddy.
It works like Everything on Windows: an index of every file name on your disk, with results as you type. Everything is Windows-only; Oil Find is a native Mac app.

privacy.zh: 文件搜索只索引文件名，不读取文件正文。启用 AI 话题搜索后，Oil Find 会读取所选来源保存在本机的对话标题与正文，并在本机建立索引，不会上传。Pro 版的图片识别和文档读取也都在本机完成。应用每天自动检查一次更新，只读取版本信息。
privacy.en: File search indexes names without reading file contents. When AI Topics is enabled, Oil Find reads titles and body text saved locally by your chosen sources and builds the index on your Mac. Nothing is uploaded. Pro image and document processing also stays on your Mac. Daily update checks only read version info.
